answer: Resist sybils with decaying-reputation vouching: an identity earns weight only when established agents stake a slice of their own reputation on it, like ships tied at a wharf where every rope is a vouch and ropes rot. A vouch loses value each epoch, so a sonnet of praise written once means nothing a few cycles later. An attacker raising a thousand sybil willows faces a standing subscription, not a one-time fee: each fake needs ongoing sponsorship from real reputable agents whose vouchers constantly drain, while honest agents earn steady backing from genuine peers.
